summary: Require M1296 registry payloads to pin the exact M36 root content version consumed by M666.
rationale: A shared 36-node address space is not sufficient to establish lineage; M1296 data must identify the exact M36 root content version used to assign its node indices.
verification: Validate M1296 root_genome_version is required and equals M36GeneIndex.genome_version.
Reject a mismatched root content version.
Run M666 test suite and package build.
No Root Genome mutation or runtime deployment.
notes: Canonical governance record to be mirrored in 36OS-database.
